note: Every sound effect in the game, made with ElevenLabs Sound Effects by tools/make-sounds.mjs. 'prompt' describes the sound, 'seconds' is how long it lasts, 'variants' is how many different takes to make (busy sounds get several so they do not get samey; the game picks one at random), 'volume' is how loud the game plays it from 0 to 1, and 'when' says where it is used. Change a prompt and run the script again to remake just that sound. 'promptInfluence' is how closely ElevenLabs follows the words (0 to 1).

sounds.prompt: A cute bouncy bingo ball dropping and landing with a soft rubber bounce, playful cartoon sound, short
sounds.when: A new number is called.

sounds.prompt: A quick light whoosh with a tiny sparkle, cartoon flick, very short
sounds.when: The called number flies into its pill.

sounds.prompt: A crisp light button press followed by a tiny swoosh, cute, very short
sounds.when: The player taps the ball to skip to the next call.

sounds.prompt: A tiny cute bubble pop, bright and clean, very short
sounds.when: A mark is placed on a square.

sounds.prompt: A tiny soft reverse bubble sucking sound, cute, very short
sounds.when: A mark is taken back or moved.

sounds.prompt: A chunky cartoon padlock clicking shut with a satisfying small thud, short
sounds.when: The ring runs out and the marks lock.

sounds.prompt: A quick energetic rising whoosh, excited start, short
sounds.when: The player taps Call bingo.

sounds.prompt: A short comical boing followed by a little deflating squeak, playful not sad
sounds.when: The next number came before the player finished calling.

sounds.prompt: A bright happy ding like a correct-answer chime, clean and short
sounds.when: A number in the checked pattern turns out valid.

sounds.prompt: A friendly cartoon wrong-answer buzzer, short, not scary
sounds.when: A number in the checked pattern is not valid.

sounds.prompt: A rising tension build with a drum roll swelling louder and louder, then stopping dead, suspenseful and playful
sounds.when: The slow, dramatic last number of a check.

sounds.prompt: A joyful cartoon bingo win fanfare with a party horn, confetti pop and cheering, celebratory and happy
sounds.when: The player wins a stage.

sounds.prompt: A gentle comical sad trombone wah-wah wah-waaah, friendly and short, not harsh
sounds.when: A claim fails the check.

sounds.prompt: A clean friendly countdown beep, single short tone
sounds.when: Each number of the 3, 2, 1 after a pause.

sounds.prompt: A higher bright friendly beep with a tiny sparkle, signalling go, short
sounds.when: The game carries on after the 3, 2, 1.

sounds.prompt: A cute soft click with a short descending tone, pausing
sounds.when: The game pauses.

sounds.prompt: A cute chunky button tap click, very short and clean
sounds.when: Any button is tapped.

sounds.prompt: A short bright celebratory jingle with a xylophone and a cheer, upbeat
sounds.when: A stage is won and the night continues.

sounds.prompt: A sparkling magical gem chime, credits earned, short and bright
sounds.when: Credits are banked.

sounds.prompt: A cute chunky toy dropping onto a wooden table with a springy bounce
sounds.when: A new prize drops onto the table.

sounds.prompt: A cheerful cash register cha-ching with a sparkle, short
sounds.when: A prize is bought.

sounds.prompt: A shimmering golden achievement sparkle with a bright triumphant chime
sounds.when: A set is finished first (gold badge).

sounds.prompt: A shimmering silver achievement chime, lighter and gentler than gold
sounds.when: A set is finished later (silver badge).

sounds.prompt: A rubber stamp thump with a tiny bell ding, short
sounds.when: A prize sells to a regular.

sounds.prompt: A tiny clock tick with a soft pop, a countdown closing, very short
sounds.when: A regular's buying ring closes.

sounds.prompt: A bright shop doorbell ding with a small whoosh, welcoming
sounds.when: The prize table opens.

sounds.prompt: A short happy crowd hooray cheer, cartoon style
sounds.when: A regular wins.

sounds.prompt: A short sympathetic cartoon aww groan from a small crowd
sounds.when: A regular loses a prize or is told off.

sounds.prompt: A short comic surprised gasp, oooh, playful
sounds.when: Someone shouts bingo and the others are shocked.
